cash.read: Profits convert strongly into cash, with total operating cash flow of ₹141,242 crore exceeding reported net profit of ₹128,726 crore over FY22 to FY26.

bull.point: The company demonstrated strong cash conversion over five years, generating operating cash flows that fully covered reported profits.

evidence.quote: Over FY22–FY26, operating cash flow of ₹141,242 crore covered all of reported profit, ₹128,726 crore.
evidence.source: Computed from screener.in's cash-flow statement and ratios

bull.point: Large deal momentum remained robust with full-year FY26 total contract value reaching $14.9 billion.

evidence.quote: Large deals were very good, $14.9 bn for the full year, $3.2 bn for the fourth quarter

bull.point: Management successfully delivered on its upgraded FY26 growth targets, achieving 3.1% constant currency revenue growth and crossing $20 billion in total revenue.

evidence.quote: We had growth of 3.1% for the full year in constant currency terms
FY26 revenues crossed $20 bn and grew 3.1% in constant currency terms, within the upgraded guidance band given in January

bear.point: Enactment of new labor codes created a significant financial impact, requiring exceptional item provisions of ₹1,289 crore in consolidated profit and loss.

evidence.quote: Accordingly, ₹1,146 crore and ₹1,289 crore has been recognized in the Standalone and Consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss, respectively, for the year ended March 31, 2026

bear.point: Management lowered the upper bound of its FY27 constant currency revenue growth guidance from 3.5% to 3.0% during the first quarter.
